import sys

def inc(a, b, mod):
    a[0] += b
    if a[0] >= mod:
        a[0] -= mod

def sumN(n):
    return n * (n + 1) // 2

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, m, mod = map(int, input[:3])
    data = list(map(int, input[3:]))

    C = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    for i in range(m + 1):
        C[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]
            if C[i][j] >= mod:
                C[i][j] -= mod

    dp1s_first = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp1s_second = [0] * (m + 1)
    dp1s_first[0] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            w = (dp1s_first[j - 1] * dp1s_first[i - j]) % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod
            inc([dp1s_second[i]], (sumN(j - 1) + sumN(i - j)) * w % mod, mod)
            inc([dp1s_second[i]], dp1s_second[j - 1] * dp1s_first[i - j] % mod * (i + 1) * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod, mod)
            inc([dp1s_second[i]], dp1s_first[j - 1] * dp1s_second[i - j] % mod * (i + 1) * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod, mod)
            inc([dp1s_first[i]], w * (i + 1) % mod, mod)

    dp2s_first = [[[0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
    dp2s_second = [[[0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
    dp2s_first[0][0][0] = 1
    dp2s_first[1][0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            for ln in range(1, n - i + 1):
                # Update dp2s[1][i+ln][j]
                inc([dp2s_first[1][i + ln][j]], dp2s_first[0][i][j], mod)
                inc([dp2s_second[1][i + ln][j]], dp2s_second[0][i][j], mod)

                # Update dp2s[0][i+ln][j+ln]
                val1 = (dp2s_first[1][i][j] * dp1s_first[ln]) % mod * C[j + ln][j] % mod
                inc([dp2s_first[0][i + ln][j + ln]], val1, mod)

                val2 = (dp2s_first[1][i][j] * dp1s_second[ln]) % mod * C[j + ln][j] % mod
                inc([dp2s_second[0][i + ln][j + ln]], val2, mod)

                val3 = (dp2s_second[1][i][j] * dp1s_first[ln]) % mod * C[j + ln][j] % mod
                inc([dp2s_second[0][i + ln][j + ln]], val3, mod)

    final_ans = dp2s_second[0][n][m]
    final_ans += dp2s_second[1][n][m]
    final_ans %= mod
    print(final_ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
